unconnected port
An unconnected port is a RPortPrototype or PPortPrototype referenced by no AssemblySwConnectors and/or DelegationSwConnectors, or with at least no DataMapping of any of the elements in the port interface. Hint: PRPortPrototypes are always treated as connected ports. (See [SWS_Rte_06030])
